There’s no need to wait for turkey time to start saving.

With Black Friday (Nov. 27, 2026) a little less than two weeks away, we’re kicking our deal-searching efforts into high gear. Plenty of early Cyber Week sales have already begun, and we’ll be continuously updating this piece with the latest and greatest.

Below, shop a few of the highlights so far — from cozy nap dresses and slippers to the K-beauty brand so many stars are talking about.

Nordstrom is decking the halls (er, its website) with deals of up to 60% off. The early Black Friday sale includes plenty of fashion finds, but we’re also eyeing the luxury beauty savings — plus, some of the best Ugg prices we’ve seen in ages.

Make being home for the holidays extra cozy with these 25%-off deals on bedding and bath products — including the Kris Jenner-approved Cuddle Blanket and the Bamboo Sheet Set Oprah once called the “softest ever.” (The latter is available in limited-edition holiday prints right now, too.)

No one does the holidays quite like Macy’s. Even before the brand’s 100th annual Thanksgiving Day Parade kicks off, you can score early Black Friday deals of up to 70% off. We spotted great savings on everything from Ugg blankets to Coach bags.

Save 25% off everything at Hill House Home’s sitewide sale, including the viral nap dresses our editors adore. (We’re in good company; everyone from Taylor Swift to Jennifer Lawrence to Anne Hathaway has worn its signature smocked styles over the years.)

There are plenty of beauty buys on sale at Ulta right now, and new deals are dropping regularly. Currently, you can save up to 50% off on brands like Dermalogica, Armani Beauty and Cymbiotika.

At J.Crew’s pre-Black Friday More Is More Sale, the more you spend, the more you save. Score 20% off purchases over $200, and 25% or 30% off purchases of over $300 or $500, respectively.

K-beauty brand Anua had a huge 2026, scoring rousing endorsements from brand ambassadors like Kendall Jenner and Melissa Gorga, the latter of whom called the PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Cream her “home Botox secret.” Ahead of Cyber Week, score up to 68% off gift-ready sets and more.

From the Kristen Bell-approved Custom Alpha Tote to plenty of phone cases and jewelry options, BaubleBar is offering 25% off customized items right now. What makes a better gift than something personal?

Who says socks are a boring present? Bombas’ ultra-soft socks and slippers are perfect for gifting — and all 25% off for a limited time.

Monica Vinader’s jewelry has attracted an A-list following, from Kate Middleton and Meghan Markle to Ariana Grande and Selena Gomez. Right now, you can save 30% off a slew of designs.

While Amazon’s official Black Friday sale doesn’t kick off until Nov. 19, you can already score early deals on everything from tech to fashion.

Plenty of famous folks swear by CurrentBody’s LED masks — and right now, several device and skin care bundles are on ahead of Black Friday.

During Lancôme’s Black Friday preview, take 30% off everything sitewide, from a Julia Roberts-approved fragrance to Kathy Hilton’s go-to mascara.

Emily Blunt and Simone Ashley carried Vestirsi bags during the “Devil Wears Prada 2” press tour earlier this year, but you needn’t be on the staff of Runway to score nearly 50% off sitewide.

Vionic’s supportive slippers have made Oprah’s Favorite Things list on numerous occasions, and this year’s was no exception. Even better? The brand’s current 30%-off sale includes the Cheyenne Mule Slipper, her 2026 pick.

If you’re giving your home a refresh in 2027, check out deals of up to 40% off on Lovesac’s modern furniture, including a slew of comfy sectionals. The brand’s previously teamed up with everyone from Travis Barker to Kathy Hilton.

Another brand known for its celeb collabs? Quay, which teamed up with the Nader sisters this summer. Whichever sunglass style catches your eye, you’ll get 20% off when you buy two non-prescription options — or 30% off on one prescription style.

Don’t sweat high prices. Save up to 50% off everything at Gymshark, including styles from Megan Thee Stallion’s campaign this fall.

Score scent-sational deals on another Oprah’s Favorite Things list alum: Snif. (While she lauded the Old Saint Wick holiday candle last year, the brand also makes a wide range of everyday scents.)

This article was written by Hannah Southwick, Commerce Associate Editor for Page Six. Hannah spies deals on actually affordable celebrity-worn styles, puts celebrities’ brands to the test and finds the beauty products that keep stars red carpet-ready. She consults stylists and industry pros — including celebs themselves — for firsthand product recommendations, trend predictions and more. In addition to writing for Page Six since 2020, her work has been featured in USA Today and Parade.

در نتایج جستجوی خود، پوشش خبری بیشتر ما را ببینید. نیازی نیست برای شروع صرفه‌جویی منتظر زمان بوقلمون بمانید. با توجه به اینکه کمتر از دو هفته به بلک فرایدی (27 نوامبر 2026) مانده است، ما تلاش‌های خود برای جستجوی تخفیف‌ها را به شدت افزایش داده‌ایم. بسیاری از حراج‌های اولیه هفته سایبری از قبل آغاز شده‌اند و ما به طور مداوم این مطلب را با جدیدترین و بهترین تخفیف‌ها به‌روزرسانی خواهیم کرد. در ادامه، می‌توانید چند مورد از بهترین تخفیف‌های فعلی را خریداری کنید — از لباس‌های راحت برای چرت زدن و دمپایی گرفته تا برند زیبایی کره‌ای که بسیاری از ستارگان درباره آن صحبت می‌کنند. نوردستروم در حال تزئین فروشگاه‌های خود (یا بهتر است بگوییم وب‌سایت خود) با تخفیف‌هایی تا 60 درصد است. حراج اولیه بلک فرایدی شامل کالاهای مد زیادی است، اما ما همچنین چشم‌مان به تخفیف‌های محصولات زیبایی لوکس است — به‌علاوه، برخی از بهترین قیمت‌های Ugg که در سال‌های اخیر دیده‌ایم. با این تخفیف‌های 25 درصدی روی محصولات رختخواب و حمام، بودن در خانه را در تعطیلات بسیار دنج‌تر کنید — از جمله پتوی Cuddle که مورد تأیید کریس جنر است و ست ملحفه‌های بامبو که اپرا زمانی آن را «نرم‌ترین ملحفه‌ای که تا به حال دیده شده» نامید. (مورد دوم در حال حاضر با طرح‌های مخصوص تعطیلات و در تعداد محدود نیز موجود است.)
هیچ‌کس به اندازه Macy’s تعطیلات را خاص نمی‌کند. حتی قبل از شروع صد‌مین رژه سالانه روز شکرگزاری این برند، می‌توانید تخفیف‌های اولیه بلک فرایدی تا 70% را دریافت کنید. ما تخفیف‌های عالی روی همه چیز، از پتوهای Ugg گرفته تا کیف‌های Coach، پیدا کردیم. در حراج سراسری Hill House Home، شامل لباس‌های راحتی ویرالی که سردبیران ما عاشق آنها هستند، 25% تخفیف روی همه چیز دریافت کنید. (ما در جمع خوبی هستیم؛ همه افراد از تیلور سوئیفت گرفته تا جنیفر لارنس و آن هتوی لباس‌های مخصوص این برند را پوشیده‌اند.

The race for the tiniest waist just got even more competitive.

New clinical trial results suggest a Chinese-made weight-loss drug could help people shed nearly 18% of their body weight in under a year.

The findings suggest the newcomer could one day outperform some of the biggest names in the booming GLP-1 market, including Wegovy and Mounjaro.

In the 48-week trial, researchers from Fudan University in Shanghai recruited 567 adults who were overweight or obese and divided them into four groups.

Three groups received weekly injections of ribupatide at doses of 2 milligrams, 4 milligrams or 6 milligrams, while the fourth received a placebo.

Behind the experimental drug is Chinese pharmaceutical giant Hengrui, which partnered with US biotech firm Kailera Therapeutics to bring ribupatide to markets outside China.

Ribupatide works by mimicking two hormones naturally produced in the gut that help regulate appetite, digestion and blood sugar.

It’s a similar approach to that used by Eli Lilly’s blockbuster drugs Mounjaro and Zepbound. But ribupatide has been designed to bind more tightly to its targets and stay active in the body longer, potentially extending its effects throughout the week.

Everyone in the study — including those given placebo shots — also followed a lifestyle program that included dietary counseling and recommendations to get at least 150 minutes of moderate exercise each week.

After 48 weeks, those taking the lowest dose of ribupatide had lost an average of 10.7% of their starting body weight. Those on the 4-milligram dose shed 16.4%, while participants taking the highest dose lost a whopping 17.7%.

The placebo group lost just 1.4%.

The numbers are in the same ballpark as — and potentially higher than — those seen with Wegovy. In a separate clinical trial, people taking a 2.4 mg dose of the popular GLP-1 shot lost an average of 14.9% of their body weight over a longer period of 68 weeks.

And ribupatide’s results could have been even more impressive. Weight loss hadn’t started to level off among participants taking the two highest doses by the end of the 11-month study, suggesting they could have lost even more with longer treatment.

And the benefits extended beyond the scale.

Although none of the participants had diabetes, researchers found that those taking ribupatide had reductions in blood sugar. They also saw improvements in blood pressure and cholesterol.

Their waistlines shrank, too — an important measurement because abdominal fat is linked to an increased risk of heart disease and other health problems.

The participants taking ribupatide saw their waist measurements drop by between 9 and 14 centimeters, compared with just 2.5 centimeters among those on the placebo.

The drug wasn’t without some familiar side effects, though. Like other GLP-1s, ribupatide most commonly caused digestive problems, including nausea, vomiting and diarrhea. The researchers said the symptoms were generally mild to moderate and occurred most often as participants increased their doses.

Study authors said their results are promising and come amid a need for more pharmacological treatment options as obesity continues to plague millions of people.

The problem is particularly acute in the US, where roughly four in 10 adults have obesity and an even larger share are overweight. Among children and teenagers ages 2 to 19, just over 21% have obesity.

It’s no wonder Americans’ appetite for weight-loss injections shows little sign of slowing. A September Gallup survey found that 11% of US adults were currently taking a GLP-1 medication for weight loss, up from just 3% in 2024.

Overall, 15% said they had taken one of the blockbuster drugs at some point in their lives — a jump of nine percentage points in just two years.

news.originalContent:

Nvidia fell Monday for the third straight day as investors panicked over the fallout from CEO Jensen Huang’s dramatic ouster – even as President Trump reportedly prepared to designate the chipmaker a “national champion.”

The chipmaker is slated to be among more than two dozen companies labeled AI “national champions” by the Trump administration sometime within the next week, which gives them special export approvals in an attempt to boost overseas business, according to the Wall Street Journal.

Nvidia’s stock was last trading down 1.2% at $160.96 a share after shedding hundreds of billions of dollars in market value last week. It has slipped below the $4 trillion mark, making Apple the world’s most valuable company with a $5.2 trillion market cap.

Huang resigned on Thursday as CEO, president and a member of the chipmaker’s board after he admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. News reports soon surfaced that he had at least two other affairs with executives at his company.

Many, however, have been calling for Huang to return to the legendary chipmaker he founded 33 years ago and grew into an industry giant – arguing the company won’t maintain its dealmaking prowess without him.

Billionaire Elon Musk is backing an online petition that has garnered more than 170,000 signatures calling for him to be brought back, despite the national security concerns around his affair with Alice Huang, a suspected Communist spy of no relation.

Huang has already agreed to testify before three House committees on China, foreign affairs and intelligence before the Thanksgiving break, and Democratic leaders – now holding powerful majorities – are also expected to haul the disgraced CEO before Congress.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Sunday urged Nvidia to pursue a “dramatic shakeup” among leadership, saying the board should look “outside the company” for its next CEO.

The Commerce Department on Monday announced that it is cracking down on a trade loophole that allowed Chinese firms to access American AI chips and computing power.

Bessent had blamed Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick’s team for the Chinese spy mess. He said the Treasury, State Department, Defense Department and US Trade Representative had been pushing for the government to blacklist Megaspeed – where Alice Huang worked – “for months.”

In a letter on Sunday, Sen. Maria Cantwell, the top Democrat on the Senate Commerce Committee, also blamed Lutnick and urged the Commerce secretary to reinforce export controls and stop the sale of AI chips to China.

The national champion program is a sign that Trump is still pushing ahead with efforts to boost AI companies and data-center construction, hopeful the industry will lead to blowout American profits.

Companies with the “national champion” designation can receive expedited export approvals, government support for work overseas and federal financing, according to the Commerce Department’s website. The program was announced a year ago, but specific champions have not been named.

Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic are expected to be included in the new program, which is an effort to help American companies succeed over Chinese rivals in foreign business deals, sources told the Wall Street Journal.

Trump reportedly called Huang last week, before the Nvidia CEO stepped down, and urged him to keep fighting for his job, according to the New York Times.

The president has also publicly defended Huang. During an interview last Thursday, Trump told Stephen A. Smith that Huang is “going through hell” and “feels most badly [about] his wife and family.” Trump also told reporters that Huang is an “honorable guy” and said “he probably has an excuse for it.”

Trump’s stake in Nvidia was between $13 million and $62 million as of the end of August, according to a Washington Post review of his financial disclosures.
news.content: در نتایج جست‌وجوی خود، پوشش خبری بیشتر ما را مشاهده کنید. سهام Nvidia روز دوشنبه برای سومین روز متوالی کاهش یافت، زیرا سرمایه‌گذاران از پیامدهای برکناری ناگهانی مدیرعامل این شرکت، جنسن هوانگ، دچار وحشت شدند – حتی در حالی که طبق گزارش‌ها، رئیس‌جمهور ترامپ در حال آماده‌سازی برای معرفی این شرکت سازنده تراشه به‌عنوان «قهرمان ملی» بود. طبق گزارش وال‌استریت ژورنال، قرار است این تولیدکننده تراشه در کنار بیش از بیست شرکت دیگر، در هفته آینده توسط دولت ترامپ به عنوان «قهرمانان ملی» هوش مصنوعی معرفی شود. این عنوان به آنها مجوزهای صادراتی ویژه‌ای می‌دهد تا بتوانند فعالیت‌های تجاری خود در خارج از کشور را تقویت کنند. سهام Nvidia در آخرین معاملات با کاهش 1.2 درصدی به 160.96 دلار به ازای هر سهم رسید، در حالی که هفته گذشته صدها میلیارد دلار از ارزش بازار خود را از دست داده بود. این رقم به زیر مرز 4 تریلیون دلار سقوط کرده است و اپل را با ارزش بازار 5.2 تریلیون دلاری به با ارزش ترین شرکت جهان تبدیل کرده است. هوانگ روز پنجشنبه پس از اعتراف به رابطه با یک جاسوس چینی از سمت مدیرعامل، رئیس و عضو هیئت مدیره تراشه ساز استعفا داد. به زودی گزارش های خبری منتشر شد مبنی بر اینکه او حداقل دو رابطه دیگر با مدیران شرکت خود داشته است. با این حال، بسیاری از هوانگ برای بازگشت به تراشه‌ساز افسانه‌ای که 33 سال پیش تأسیس کرد و به یک غول صنعت تبدیل شد، خواستار شده‌اند - با این استدلال که این شرکت بدون او قدرت معامله‌گری خود را حفظ نخواهد کرد. میلیاردر ایلان ماسک از یک طومار آنلاین حمایت می‌کند که علی‌رغم اینکه بیش از 170000 امضای امنیت ملی به همراه او جلب شده است. هوانگ، یک جاسوس مظنون کمونیست

It’s no secret that lead deckhand Matt Fitzpatrick-Buck has very little confidence in Alex Wright as his bosun on Below Deck Season 13. Early in the charter season, Fitzpatrick-Buck expressed his concerns to Captain Kerry Titheradge, who assured Fitzpatrick-Buck that he was aware of Wright’s shortcomings.

In this exclusive clip from tonight’s all-new episode, Fitzpatrick-Buck is still frustrated with Wright and his organizational skills. The clip begins at 7:45 AM with Fitzpatrick-Buck standing in the lazarette staring at the equipment and water toys that were left out overnight. “This place is not good at all,” says Fitzpatrick-Buck to himself as he assesses the mess. He swears to himself and sits down dejectedly on a cooler. “Sick and tired of doing everything,” mumbles Fitzpatrick-Buck. “Fucking Alex.”

In his confessional, Fitzpatrick-Buck continues to complain. “I’m mad because it’s a fucking buildup over the last two, three weeks,” explains Fitzpatrick-Buck. “Waking up this morning with the boat a fucking mess…I’m sick and tired of cleaning up. I’m fucking over it. Enough is enough.”

Next, Fitzpatrick-Buck goes to the wheelhouse to speak with Titheradge once again about his displeasure with Wright. “Fuck, I’m getting frustrated,” says Fitzpatrick-Buck to Titheradge. “I respect Alex as a person, but I keep on picking up his slack, and it’s pissing me off.”

Titheradge encourages Fitzpatrick-Buck to share his grievances. “Last night, he didn’t give James the job list, and there’s shit tons of stuff to do,” begins Fitzpatrick-Buck. “The last two days on deck, he’s late.” Then, Fitzpatrick-Buck’s complaints get personal. “He just rolls out of bed, doesn’t brush his teeth. He spends the first thirty minutes doing nothing.”

Titheradge listens intently to Fitzpatrick-Buck’s grievances. “I just don’t respect him as a bosun,” finishes Fitzpatrick-Buck. Clearly disappointed by Fitzpatrick-Buck’s observations, Titheradge can only rub his brow in frustration.

Will Titheradge demote Wright and promote Fitzpatrick-Buck? Will Wright get the chance to plead his case? Tune in to Bravo tonight at 8 PM ET for an all-new episode of Below Deck to find out!

در نتایج جستجوی خود، پوشش خبری بیشتری از ما ببینید. هیچ‌کس نمی‌داند که مت فیتزپاتریک-باک، ملوان ارشد، اعتماد بسیار کمی به الکس رایت به‌عنوان ناخدا‌یار خود در فصل ۱۳ Below Deck دارد. در اوایل فصل اجاره، فیتزپاتریک-باک نگرانی‌های خود را به کاپیتان کری تیتریدج ابراز کرد و کاپیتان به فیتزپاتریک-باک اطمینان داد که از نقاط ضعف رایت آگاه است. در این کلیپ اختصاصی از قسمت کاملاً جدید امشب، فیتزپاتریک-باک همچنان از رایت و مهارت‌های مدیریتی او ناراضی است. کلیپ ساعت 7:45 صبح شروع می‌شود و فیتزپاتریک-باک را نشان می‌دهد که در انبار عقب قایق ایستاده و به تجهیزات و اسباب‌بازی‌های آبی که شب قبل بیرون مانده بودند، خیره شده است. فیتزپاتریک-باک در حالی که این به‌هم‌ریختگی را بررسی می‌کند، با خود می‌گوید: «اینجا اصلاً خوب نیست.» او زیر لب فحش می‌دهد و ناامید روی یک یخچال قابل حمل می‌نشیند. فیتزپاتریک-باک زیر لب غر می‌زند: «از اینکه همه کارها را خودم انجام دهم، خسته و کلافه‌ام.» «لعنتی الکس.»
فیتزپاتریک-باک در اتاق اعتراف همچنان به شکایت ادامه می‌دهد. فیتزپاتریک-باک توضیح می‌دهد: «عصبانی‌ام چون این وضعیت لعنتی در طول دو، سه هفته گذشته انباشته شده است.» «امروز صبح که از خواب بیدار شدم، قایق لعنتی بهم‌ریخته بود… از تمیز کردن خسته و کلافه‌ام. دیگر بس است. دیگه بسه.» بعد، فیتزپاتریک-باک به اتاق فرمان می‌رود تا یک بار دیگر با تیثردج درباره نارضایتی‌اش از رایت صحبت کند. فیتزپاتریک-باک به تیثردج می‌گوید: «لعنتی، دارم کلافه می‌شوم.» «من به الکس به عنوان یک شخص احترام می‌گذارم، اما مدام دارم کارهای عقب‌افتاده‌اش را انجام می‌دهم و این موضوع مرا عصبانی می‌کند.»
تیثردج فیتزپاتریک-باک را تشویق می‌کند تا نارضایتی‌های خود را بیان کند.

A sick hospital security guard who was caught having sex with an elderly woman’s corpse in a morgue freezer is now facing up to 15 years in prison.

An Arizona jury last week found Randall Bird, 49, guilty of having sex with a dead person — three years after he was discovered by colleagues in the freezer with his belt off and fly down next to the partially naked body of a 79-year-old woman.

The victim, who had died of natural causes, was lying face down on top of a gurney with her body bag unzipped, with Bird’s duty belt on top of her, in the morgue at Banner University Medical Center in Phoenix, according to charging documents obtained by AZ Family after his arrest in November 2023.

The necrophile’s uniform appeared “messy,” and he was “sweating profusely” and “acting very nervous,” co-workers told police.

“They stated that [Bird] had removed his duty belt, which they observed on top of a gurney where a bagged deceased body was placed. [Bird’s] zipper on his uniform pants was wide open, and the rest of his uniform looked all messy,” police wrote in the documents.

“The victim’s hospital gown had been rolled up above her belly button area, exposing her naked body from the waist down,” investigators added, according to The Smoking Gun.

The twisted body desecration was discovered when Bird’s colleagues, who were other security guards, arrived at work around 5:30 a.m. and the main entrance to the morgue unlocked, which was unusual. They then saw the freezer cracked open and inside spotted Bird, who frantically tried to cover the woman’s body.

He told them he had suffered a medical episode, causing him to grab the victim’s body as he fainted and fell to the floor, the documents said.

He insisted the woman’s body bag tore and its zipper broke as a result — but the workers didn’t buy it and reported him to their supervisors. He told police the same story when they interviewed him days later.

Security guards at the hospital are tasked only with transporting dead bodies to the morgue and placing them inside a freezer and are not supposed to open the body bags, officials said.

Investigators collected evidence from the victim and Bird and confirmed his DNA was found on the victim. Post-mortem rib fractures were also found on the victim’s body.

Bird was convicted Thursday by a jury in Arizona Superior Court on four counts of sexual conduct with a dead person, court records show.

He is scheduled to be sentenced Dec. 18, where he is facing between 12 and 45 months for each charge for a maximum of 15 years.

British women convicted of illegally terminating their pregnancies under a Victorian-era law will be automatically pardoned Monday, the government said.

The action follows Parliament’s passage last year of a landmark vote to decriminalize abortion by repealing a section from the 1861 Offences Against the Person Act.

Women who have received a caution from police will also be pardoned and women arrested or investigated for ending their own pregnancy will have those details removed from their criminal records. They will not have to apply for pardons and some will be issued posthumously.

“For too long, women have faced the devastating consequences of outdated abortion laws,” said Heidi Stewart, chief executive of the British Pregnancy Advisory Service. “While no pardon can undo the distress and trauma these women have experienced, this historic change in the law recognizes the profound harm caused by their criminalization and represents a meaningful step towards justice.”

The government did not provide the number of women affected. But Tonia Antoniazzi, the Labour member of Parliament who introduced the decriminalization amendment, said police had investigated more than 100 women suspected of illegal abortions in the five years preceding last year’s vote. That included some who suffered natural miscarriages and stillbirths.

Antoniazzi described how women suspected of illegally aborting a fetus were once “dragged from hospital beds to police cells” and interrogated when they should have been cared for.

“This trauma cannot be erased, but I hope that this offers some alleviation of the pain these women have endured, enabling them to participate fully in society again, living their lives to the full, working the jobs they’ve always wanted to,” she said.

Under current law, doctors can legally carry out abortions in England, Scotland and Wales up to 24 weeks, and beyond that under special circumstances, such as when the life of the mother is in danger. Abortion in Northern Ireland was decriminalized in 2019.

Under the Crime and Policing Act that took effect this spring, women who terminate a pregnancy at any stage will not face criminal charges.

The measure was opposed by anti-abortion groups that argued it would open the door to abortion on demand at any stage of pregnancy.

The law was changed after high-profile prosecutions, including the jailing of a mother of three that caused an outcry from abortion rights supporters.

Carla Foster was sentenced to more than two years in prison in 2023 for medically inducing an abortion about eight months into her pregnancy. An appeals court freed her a month later, saying the case called for “compassion, not punishment.”

Another woman, Nicola Packer, was acquitted on a charge of unlawfully self-administering poison or a noxious thing with intent to procure a miscarriage. Packer, who took abortion medicine when she was about 26 weeks pregnant, testified that she did not know she had been pregnant more than 10 weeks.

پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. دولت گفت، زنان بریتانیایی که به دلیل خاتمه غیرقانونی حاملگی خود بر اساس قانون دوران ویکتوریا محکوم شده اند، دوشنبه به طور خودکار مورد عفو قرار خواهند گرفت. این اقدام پس از تصویب سال گذشته رای مهم پارلمان برای غیرقانونی کردن سقط جنین با لغو بخشی از قانون 1861 جنایات علیه شخص انجام می شود. زنانی که از پلیس اخطار دریافت کرده اند نیز مورد عفو قرار خواهند گرفت و زنانی که به دلیل پایان دادن به بارداری خود دستگیر یا تحت بازجویی قرار می گیرند، این جزئیات از سوابق کیفری آنها حذف خواهد شد. آنها مجبور نخواهند بود برای عفو درخواست کنند و برخی پس از مرگ صادر خواهند شد. هایدی استوارت، مدیر اجرایی سرویس مشاوره بارداری بریتانیا، گفت: «برای مدت طولانی، زنان با عواقب ویرانگر قوانین منسوخ سقط جنین روبرو بوده اند. در حالی که هیچ بخششی نمی تواند ناراحتی و آسیبی را که این زنان تجربه کرده اند جبران کند، این تغییر تاریخی در قانون آسیب عمیق ناشی از جرم انگاری آنها را به رسمیت می شناسد و نشان دهنده گامی معنادار به سوی عدالت است.

WASHINGTON — The new youngest member of Congress wants you to know one thing about Gen Z.

“Sometimes we hear, ‘Oh, this younger generation, they’re afraid to work.’ That is not true,” insisted Michael Alfonso, a former brick-layer and the 26-year-old Republican congressman-elect from Wisconsin, to The Post.

“The younger generation is ready to work,” said Alfonso, the son-in-law of Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and Fox News personality Rachel Campos-Duffy.

“They just want to be paid well, and they want an economy that will actually deliver them results for their hard work.”

Alfonso, who is married to the Duffys’ oldest daughter Evita, made history earlier this month by winning Wisconsin’s 7th Congressional District seat. He will become the youngest member of Congress when he takes office in January, besting 29-year-old Rep. Maxwell Frost (D-Fla.).

The 26-year-old ran on an “America First” platform with support from President Trump while overcoming complaints about alleged inexperience and nepotism.

The seat he scored was once held by his father-in-law.

Alfonso said he is motivated to make policy changes in Washington to give young people more opportunities, such as by trying to open up home-buying for them, touting the value of trade schools and two-year tech programs and by tackling affordability issues in general.

The congressman-elect, who mixed concrete and laid brick to pay his way through the University of Wisconsin-Madison, then produced former FBI Deputy Director Dan Bongino’s podcast, said Gen Zers are the victims of “dereliction of duty” by their elders.

“We lie to this younger generation,” he said, referring to, for example, the belief that a four-year college degree is the sure route to success.

The younger generation also has to deal with the difficulty of becoming a homeowner.

Alfonso pegged the age of the typical first-time homebuyer at 41, similar to the National Association of Realtors’ estimate of 40.

“It’s up there,” he said. “I mean, it’s ridiculous.”

Alfonso won his seat by 12.8 percentage points Nov. 3, following in the footsteps of Duffy, who repped the rural district between 2011 and 2019.

He noted that unfortunately, his party will spend the 120th Congress in the minority in both the House and Senate.

“We got our teeth kicked in,” Alfonso said.

To try to begin leading the House GOP out of the wilderness, Alfonso has thrown his support behind Rep. Jim Jordan (R-Ohio) as the chamber’s next minority leader, the young pol said.

“He’s not necessarily a new face [in the House], but a new face in leadership to maybe kick us in the right direction,” the fresh-faced legislator explained. “We’ve always been the party of meritocracy. Jim Jordan is getting his shot here.

“Focusing here at home should be really our top concern, if not only concern,” Alfonso added when asked if his party had neglected kitchen-table issues over the past two years.

He recalled what his famous father-in-law told him when he revealed he was running for his old seat.

“‘Oh boy, it’s a lot of work. I hope you’re ready for it,’ ” Alfonso said Duffy told him.

Alfonso said he went through four pairs of shoes campaigning.

“If at 26 I can’t be the hardest-working member of Congress, I shouldn’t be here anyways,” he quipped to The Post.

پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود بیشتر مشاهده کنید. واشنگتن - جوانترین عضو جدید کنگره از شما می خواهد که یک چیز را در مورد ژنرال Z بدانید. مایکل آلفونسو، یک لایه آجری سابق و 26 ساله جمهوری خواه از کنگره تا کنگره کنگره، اصرار داشت: "گاهی اوقات می شنویم، "اوه، این نسل جوان، آنها می ترسند کار کنند." آلفونسو، داماد وزیر حمل و نقل شان دافی و شخصیت فاکس نیوز ریچل کامپوس دافی، گفت: "نسل جوان آماده کار است."
آلفونسو که با اویتا دختر بزرگ دافی ازدواج کرده است، اوایل این ماه با کسب کرسی منطقه هفتم کنگره در ویسکانسین تاریخ ساز شد. او با غلبه بر شکایات در مورد ادعای بی‌تجربگی و خویشاوندی، او جوان‌ترین عضو کنگره خواهد بود که در ژانویه به ریاست جمهوری رسید و از نماینده 29 ساله ماکسول فراست (D-Fla.) پیشی گرفت. آلفونسو گفت که انگیزه دارد در واشنگتن تغییراتی در سیاست ایجاد کند تا فرصت‌های بیشتری به جوانان بدهد، مانند تلاش برای باز کردن خرید خانه برای آنها، تبلیغ ارزش مدارس تجاری و برنامه‌های فناوری دو ساله و به طور کلی پرداختن به مسائل مربوط به مقرون به صرفه بودن.

news.originalContent:
سرانجام پس از مدت‌ها گمانه‌زنی، بازیگر نقش جیمز باند پس از دنیل کریگ انتخاب شد. حساب‌های رسمی جیمز باند در شبکه‌های اجتماعی کمی قبل تصویر رابرت پتینسون در نقش جیمز باند را اسلحه‌ به دست و تاکسیدو به تن منتشر کرده‌اند.

این بازیگر انگلیسی در بیانیه‌ای گفت: «جیمز باند یکی از افسانه‌ای‌ترین شخصیت‌های سینماست و اینکه نقش ۰۰۷ را به من سپرده‌اند، بزرگ‌ترین افتخار زندگی‌ام است.»

«از همه کسانی که در استودیوهای آمازون ام‌جی‌ام به من اعتماد کردند، صمیمانه سپاسگزارم. این نقش، رویایی است که به حقیقت پیوسته، حق مطلب را ادا نمی‌کند. بی‌اندازه برای این همکاری و کاری که با این تیم فوق‌العاده پیش رو داریم، هیجان‌زده‌ام.»

پتینسون ۴۰ ساله با بازی در نقش ادوارد کالن در مجموعه‌فیلم حماسهٔ گرگ‌ومیش شهرتی جهانی پیدا کرد. او در فیلم تنت به کارگردانی کریستوفر نولان نیز نقش یک جاسوس را بازی کرده بود و مدتی قبل هم فیلم اودیسه، دیگر همکاری این دو نفر روی پرده سینماها رفت.

رابرت پتینسون همچنین پس از سه فیلم بتمن به کارگردانی نولان که کریستین بیل نقش اول را بازی می‌کرد، در فیلم بتمن (۲۰۲۲) ساخته مت ریوز نقش این ابر قهرمان را بازی کرد و قرار است در ادامه هم چنین نقشی را اجرا کند. به این ترتیب برای اولین بار در تاریخ سینما بازیگر بتمن و جیمز باند یک نفر خواهد بود.

دنی ویلنوو، کارگردان فیلم بعدی جیمز باند، نیز درباره انتخاب این بازیگر گفت: «پیش از هر چیز، می‌خواهم از بازیگران فوق‌العاده‌ای که در این مسیر همراهمان شدند، صمیمانه تشکر کنم. استعدادهای بی‌نظیری دور ما بودند، اما فقط یک نفر می‌تواند ۰۰۷ باشد.»

«از اینکه رابرت پتینسون را به‌عنوان جیمز باند تازه‌مان خوشامد می‌گوییم، از ته دل خوشحالم. او روح همیشگی ۰۰۷ را دارد و حال‌وهوایی کاملا تازه با خودش می‌آورد. برای شروع کار لحظه‌شماری می‌کنم.»

ایمی پاسکال و دیوید هیمن، دو تهیه‌کننده سرشناس فیلم بعدی جیمز باند، می‌گویند که با حضور رابرت پتینسون «میراث این شخصیت به دست آدم درستی سپرده شده است».

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

این دو در بیانیه‌ای مشترک گفتند: «جیمز باند یکی از محبوب‌ترین، الهام‌بخش‌ترین و ماندگارترین شخصیت‌های ادبیات و سینماست و در عین حال، هنوز رازآلود مانده است.»

«میراث این شخصیت به دست آدم درستی سپرده شده است. جسارت او در بازیگری، شوخ‌طبعی‌اش در دست انداختن خودش و توانایی‌اش در اینکه مدام خودش را از نو بسازد، او را به باندی بی‌نقص برای روزگار ما تبدیل می‌کند.»

پاسکال تهیه‌کننده فیلم‌هایی از جمله «شکارچیان روح»، «زنان کوچک» و «مرد عنکبوتی: به درون دنیای عنکبوتی» بوده و برای همین فیلم آخر در سال ۲۰۱۹ جایزه گلدن گلوب را برده است.

هیمن از سال ۱۹۹۲ در صنعت سینما فعالیت می‌کند و ۱۲ جایزه برده است که بیشترشان برای کارهایش در مجموعه فیلم‌های «هری پاتر» و «پدینگتون» بوده است.

پیش از این فقط شش بازیکن، در نقش این ابرجاسوس بریتانیایی بازی کرده‌اند:

انتظار می‌رود تولید این فیلم سال ۲۰۲۷ آغاز شود و سال ۲۰۲۸ اکران شود. هنوز تاریخ دقیقی اعلام نشده است. برنامه‌های فیلمسازی معمولا بسیار تغییرپذیرند اما روشن است که کار ساخت این فیلم حسابی پیش رفته و کارگردان و نویسنده آن مشخص شده‌اند.

این بیست‌وششمین فیلم مجموعه رسمی باند خواهد بود ولی نام آن هنوز تایید نشده است.

news.originalContent:
Photo by Sean Gallup/Getty Images

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation may have removed the last roadblock to tighter artificial intelligence (AI) chip export rules for China.

Nvidia’s Board of Directors in mid-November tapped its executive vice president and chief financial officer Colette Kress as its interim CEO; Kress also opposes stricter chip export controls. China hawks have used Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy and his subsequent resignation to push for more stringent rules against exporting AI chips to China.

President Donald Trump in mid-November authorized a crackdown on companies that gave chips to China, but Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick reportedly blocked the proposal, arguing it would start a trade war with China, per Axios. (RELATED: Jensen Huang’s Mistress Allegedly Helped Move More Than $7 Billion In Nvidia Chips To China)

Huang first conceived of founding Nvidia in 1993 at a Denny’s diner in San Jose, California and spent more than three decades building the company into the political and technology behemoth it is today, per CNN, controlling roughly three-quarters of the AI chip market, according to Yahoo Finance.

“Sincerely, It is a sad day for the company and for the U.S. technology industry. But, I am optimistic about Nvidia’s future. American tech is too important, too dynamic, and too prosperous to be pinned on the shoulders of any one man,” Ryan Fedasiuk, a senior fellow at the Foundation for American Innovation (FAI) told the Daily Caller News Foundation.

The Nvidia founder developed a close relationship with Trump, lobbying the president to allow Nvidia to send the H200, an advanced AI chip, to China, the Wall Street Journal reported.

“After Steve Jobs left Apple, Apple was not Apple anymore. I think Jensen is a similar kind of figure, where he is very uniquely central to the neurological operation, the brain of Nvidia’s operation, and the board certainly knows that,” Kristian Stout, the director of innovation policy at the International Center for Law & Economics, told the DCNF.

However, Huang may be plotting to return as the company’s CEO, with some allies such as SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and Epic Games chief Tim Sweeney urging Nvidia’s board to “Bring Jensen Back,” according to the Financial Times. The U.S. intelligence community has yet to provide a definitive answer if Alice Huang served as a spy for China, according to CNN.

Nvidia did not respond to a Daily Caller News Foundation request for comment.

The White House did not respond to a DCNF comment request about how the administration may change its position on export controls and if it is willing to work with Democrats on the issue.

Kress now takes the reins at Nvidia at a key moment for the world’s largest chipmaker, which relies on China roughly 7% of its revenue during the first half of 2026, per Investing Live, and she has said that limiting chip sales to China could boost its competitors there, according to the NYT.

“Colette has helped lead NVIDIA through a period of extraordinary growth and has a deep understanding of our business, customers, operations and financial position,” Harvey Jones, chair of the Nvidia Board of Directors, said in a statement, per an Nvidia press release.

“I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years. We will continue advancing the work that has made NVIDIA a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead,” Kress said.

Huang interviewed 22 candidates before choosing Kress to be the chipmaker’s lead financial officer, the NYT reported.

Kress worked with Huang to transition the company from a leading maker of video game graphics chips to become the frontier developer of AI chips, per the Times.

As Kress takes the mantle, Trump called for Apple Executive Chairman Tim Cook to take over at Nvidia.

“NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend!,” Trump wrote on Truth Social in November.

After Huang’s resignation, congressional leaders say enacting stricter chip controls appears more likely than ever.

“The biggest threat to these bills was always that Jensen Huang used his political capital with the White House and even Congress to block them,” a lobbyist at an AI group told The Hill. “And that obstacle just got blown up. The percentage of these bills passing now are astronomically high,”

Lawmakers are already circling the wagons.

There is a “high probability” that Congress puts more restrictions on chip exports to China, Senate Majority Leader John Thune told Semafor in November.

“Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s decision to resign does not absolve him, other executives, or the company as a whole of responsibility for putting our national security at risk or for any potential violations of our laws,” Massachusetts Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren, likely the next Senate Banking Committee chair, said in a written statement on in November, per Reuters.

These calls for tighter regulations follow after leading Chinese AI company Moonshot AI accessed advanced AI chips this summer, Bloomberg News reported. Moonshot also looked to lease 8,000 chips-worth of computing power from European data centers, CNBC reported.

Warren and Indiana Republican Sen. Jim Banks called to pass the AI Overwatch Act this week through the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), a must-pass defense bill. The legislation would have the Commerce Department ensure that the advanced AI chips do not aid the military, intelligence and surveillance capabilities of America’s adversaries, per a press release from Warren’s office.

The bill is included in the Senate version of the NDAA, although negotiations on a finalized bill remain ongoing, per a press release from Banks’ office.

Fedasiuk noted there are legislative solutions that may stop Chinese access to top AI chips, such as the Remote Access Security Act, a bill Pennsylvania Republican Sen. Dave McCormick and Oregon Democratic Sen. Ron Wyden proposed in December 2025, per Congress.gov. The bill was also included in the Senate version of the NDAA, per Voice of America.

He said that the legislation would stipulate that data centers that buy American hardware maintain logs to “vet” their customers by implementing “know-your-customer” standards.

Other bills such as the Chip Security Act and the MATCH Act made it into the Senate version of the NDAA, per Punchbowl News.

Nebraska Republican Sen. Pete Ricketts sponsored the Multilateral Alignment of Technology Controls on Hardware (MATCH) Act, which would bar access to the equipment needed to make AI chips, per Americans for Responsible Innovation (ARI).

BREAKING: The CHIP Security Act just got voted out of committee. Advanced AI chips are the crown jewels of American tech leadership. Stopping chip smuggling must be a national priority. Thank you to @RepHuizenga for his leadership on moving this critical bill forward. https://t.co/vcE56bXC5f

Arkansas Republican Sen. Tom Cotton proposed the Chip Security Act, a bill that would require advanced AI chip exports be equipped with location-verification to prevent smuggling into China and other restricted countries, per Congress.gov.

“My personal view is that AI is the most important technology of our time, and it has a critical enabler. We need devices that turn electricity into tokens. They’re very hard to make. They’re a rare special commodity that only a handful of companies in the world are capable of producing. Nvidia and AMD are some of them, and China is far behind,” Fedasiuk said.

“I’d like to deny China that resource. You don’t have to believe anything else about the U.S. trade relationship with China to think that that’s a good idea,” Fedasiuk added.

Chip control critics believe it will push China to boost its own industry and may harm American businesses.

Stout noted that Chinese company Huawei has started producing its own AI hardware chips, citing the need for self-reliance, according to Reuters.

“I want America to be dominant and to be the one who wins. I just think that the aims that they’re pursuing could easily backfire, and there’s evidence that they are backfiring,” Stout warned.

However, for Cass, the Nvidia reports showcase that the American people may be right to be suspicious of the country’s largest technology companies.

“I think there was already a deep suspicion that big tech doesn’t necessarily have the ordinary American’s interests at heart, and there was no reason to trust that the progress of this technology was going to mean progress or better lives for most people, and finding out that the head of the biggest such company was literally in bed with the Chinese Communist Party is not going to make anybody feel better about the situation,” Cass remarked.

عکس از شان گالوپ/گتی ایماژ
استعفای جنسن هوانگ، مدیرعامل انویدیا، ممکن است آخرین مانع برای قوانین سخت‌تر صادرات تراشه‌های هوش مصنوعی (AI) برای چین را از بین ببرد. هیئت مدیره انویدیا در اواسط نوامبر، معاون اجرایی و مدیر مالی آن، کولت کرس را به عنوان مدیرعامل موقت خود انتخاب کرد. کرس همچنین با کنترل‌های سخت‌تر صادرات تراشه‌ها مخالف است. شاهین‌های چین از رابطه هوانگ با یک جاسوس چینی و استعفای بعدی او برای اعمال قوانین سخت‌گیرانه‌تر علیه صادرات تراشه‌های هوش مصنوعی به چین استفاده کرده‌اند. رئیس‌جمهور دونالد ترامپ در اواسط نوامبر مجوز سرکوب شرکت‌هایی را صادر کرد که تراشه‌ها را به چین می‌دادند، اما هوارد لوتنیک، وزیر بازرگانی چین، بنا بر گزارش‌ها، جنگی را با چین آغاز کرد. (مرتبط: گفته می شود معشوقه جنسن هوانگ به انتقال بیش از ۷ میلیارد دلار تراشه های انویدیا به چین کمک کرده است)
بر اساس گزارش یاهو فایننس، هوانگ برای اولین بار در سال 1993 در یک غذاخوری دنی در سن خوزه، کالیفرنیا، انویدیا را تاسیس کرد و بیش از سه دهه را صرف ساخت این شرکت به غول سیاسی و فناوری کرد که امروز، طبق گفته CNN، کنترل تقریباً سه چهارم بازار تراشه‌های هوش مصنوعی را در دست دارد. رایان فداسیوک، یکی از اعضای ارشد بنیاد نوآوری آمریکایی، به Dail (FAI) گفت: "با احترام، این روز غم انگیزی برای شرکت و صنعت فناوری ایالات متحده است. اما من به آینده انویدیا خوشبین هستم. فناوری آمریکایی بسیار مهم، پویا و مرفه تر از آن است که بتوان آن را روی دوش یک مرد قرار داد."

news.originalContent:
Eight men killed in shooting near Pietermaritzburg while six men and three women shot dead near Pretoria.

At least 17 people have been killed in two separate mass shootings in South Africa, police said.

Eight men were found dead late on Sunday in a “bullet-riddled” vehicle in Sweetwaters, outside the city of Pietermaritzburg, police said.

Hours later, nine people were found dead in Jeffsville, an informal settlement near South Africa’s capital, Pretoria, police said. The bodies of six men and three women were discovered inside a shack with gunshot wounds.

National Police Commissioner Fannie Masemola said on Monday that investigators had not established motives for the crimes that took place 530 kilometres (330 miles) apart.

“The ongoing mass shootings which we encounter are unacceptable. Definitely, we have to find these criminals. We cannot allow them to terrorise communities or determine how people live their lives,” Masemola said.

South Africa has struggled for years with high rates of violent crime, but has had a recent surge in mass shootings with high death tolls.

Reporting from Pretoria, Al Jazeera’s Clement Manyathela said the community was “gripped by fear” as it waits for answers about the shooting.

He said the victims were found in a four-room shack, where the killings happened just before midnight. A young child who went into the shack looking for a relative made the discovery, he said.

Pathologists, investigators and officers were working to establish what happened.

Gauteng Police Commissioner Tommy Mthombeni said one of those killed was a “person of interest” in a shooting last year in the nearby informal settlement of Saulsville, in which 12 people were killed and 13 wounded, the Associated Press news agency reported.

“We cannot rule out that they may be linked, and may possibly have been a retaliation attack,” Mthombeni said.

In the Pietermaritzburg shooting, police spokesperson Robert Netshiunda said some families had come forward to help identify victims.

“It’s still too early to tell what the motive could have been and who could be behind the shooting because we are yet to identify the victims,” said Netshiunda.

Below is State of the Day, a morning newsletter from the Daily Caller Editorial Desk. Sign up here.__________

Welcome to State of the Day,

Turns out, draining the swamp isn’t nearly as lucrative as owning it,

What Does $25 Million Buy You At The White House?

I think it’s safe to say Jensen Huang had a week from hell.

The Nvidia co-founder and CEO resigned last Thursday amid mounting reports of extramarital relationships, including one with a suspected Chinese honey pot and two others with his subordinates at Nvidia.

But as the tech and political worlds alike sift through the former CEO’s personal life, there’s another relationship of Huang’s worth a closer look: his ties to the White House.

The tech company committed $25 million to President Donald Trump’s illustrious ballroom. The company initially asked that the donation remain anonymous, but we slimy journalists didn’t let that fly.

The timing is what’s important here. Nvidia’s contribution hit the bank less than three months after the company struck a deal with the Trump administration, allowing it to sell its advanced chips to China, despite national security concerns.

And while Nvidia insists the donation was independent of its business interests, it’s not the easiest lie to believe.

But before you label me anti-Nvidia, let me talk about the other companies and individuals using cash infusions into the Trump world to gain access to the commander in chief.

The internal donor list, scooped by The Washington Post, revealed the funding operation for the ballroom secured $333 million in private contributions.

At least 77 million of that came from anonymous donors.

The best bit? Companies and their C-suite execs with federal contracts during Trump’s second term accounted for about half the total haul. Yep, that includes Nvidia.

And the ballroom is just one cash register in Trump’s increasingly expansive fundraising operation.

How kind of them — corruption comes now with preferred payment methods, who knew?

MAGA Inc., Trump’s primary fundraising vehicle, has raised nearly $450 million since the start of 2025.

A New York Times investigation found that Trump and his allies have raised nearly $2 billion for his political and personal causes, including the White House Ballroom, America250, and MAGA Inc., among others.

The NYT traced around half a billion of those contributions to 346 major donors.

More than half of those benefited from administration actions or worked in industries that had.

One particularly egregious example is Extremity Care, a medical company that produces skin-substitute bandages — and for a pretty penny at that. The company gave $5 million to MAGA Inc.

That donation landed one executive an invite to a Mar-a-Lago dinner, where he got the chance to briefly lobby the president on delaying Medicare restrictions on their products. He even handed Trump a flier, in true lobbyist fashion, which the president posted to his social media the next day.

The next month, the administration pushed off its planned restrictions.

And just like every good business deal, the company gave the ballroom $5 million as a thank you.

If you don’t see the pay-to-play politics here — squint — because I’m not sure it gets any clearer.

And that’s just the tip of the iceberg. Isabela Herrera gave $3.5 million to MAGA Inc. and then $2.5 million to the ballroom.

Her father, who faced federal bribery charges, received a pardon in January.

The Times investigation also reported that lobbyists cozy with the White House would tell clients to contribute to various groups, like MAGA Inc., to win over the president.

In case you might be missing what’s going on here — getting close to Trump has become an industry in and of itself.

Washington has a revolving door between the government and the lobbying sectors. Someone goes and works in the White House. They make friends, get to know who the power brokers are, and then jump ship to work for a lobbying firm.

There, they advise people looking for pardons, eased regulations, or anything else the President might be able to do for someone, and they tell those people who to talk to, where to send their money, and essentially serve as a middleman for corruption.

Take Ballard Partners, for example: Susie Wiles called the firm home for nearly a decade as a managing partner.

And you guessed it, they’ve been raking in cash since Trump took office. Collecting more than $88 million in lobbying revenue last year and $98 million in just the first three quarters of this year — on the up and up!

One of Ballard’s notable clients? None other than Extremity Care, which paid the firm $710,000 over a year and a half to lobby on the company’s behalf.

But it’s not all doom and gloom.

Trump recently announced he was parting ways with Susie Wiles, his former chief of staff. Who, by all accounts, was no angel. He’s replaced her with former Deputy Chief of Staff Stephen Miller. And despite his polarizing status in American politics, it’s safe to say he at least understands how horrible the optics are on the White House’s corruption problem.

On Friday, Miller introduced a new rule requiring White House staff to obtain approval from the Office of White House Counsel before meeting with registered lobbyists about government policy on White House grounds.

And while it definitely seems like a step in the right direction, it’ll be a minute before we know whether it’s all for show or a genuine change.

The White House Counsel’s Office could simply approve every meeting, or lobbyists could move their meetings off-site. If there’s anything to know about lobbyists in the Beltway, it’s that they could give any car salesman a run for his money when it comes to getting in the room.

So I’m not entirely convinced just yet. Nevertheless, requiring oversight of lobbyist meetings is a common-sense measure, and the administration should be held to its word on this one.

Ultimately, the only meaningful way we’ll know whether this White House is going to start putting ordinary Americans ahead of oligarchs — unlike how they’ve operated over the last two years — is to look at the policies coming out of the White House.

Are regulators still playing favorites? Are government contracts being handed out on actual merit, or are they patting their friends on the back? Are pardons being given out as party favors at the ballroom donor party, or are they correcting genuine miscarriages of justice?

As I’ve said before, Trump spent nearly a decade building his political ethos around taking on the swamp, the Washington establishment, and the uniparty alike. But just like his other promises, this administration has embraced the very system he campaigned against with open arms.

Miller’s memo offers some hope that change may be coming. But it’s not concrete proof of anything. The president can make lobbyists sign their names at the White House doors; he can’t stop Americans from asking who gets what once they’re actually inside.

Only the policies coming out of his administration will tell whether the government has decided to actually work for the people it represents.

‘Backroom conversations’ derail data center group —Miranda Willson, POLITICO

One of the nation’s biggest climate funders worked to bring tech giants, environmental groups and business interests to the table to discuss guidelines for the data center boom. However, the initiative quickly ran into trouble. The event exposed a growing divide within the climate movement over whether to work with or fight the companies driving the so-called AI boom. Read more on the factions emerging alongside the new technology from POLITICO’s Miranda Willson.

news.originalContent:
Ukraine’s military has been relying on the internet service since December 2024 to intercept Russian drones.

Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that limits on SpaceX’s Starshield military-grade internet service are disrupting Ukrainian drone operations and hindering the country’s war effort against Russia.

Over the weekend, two people were killed in a Russian jet-powered drone attack on what Ukrainian officials called “critical infrastructure” in the northern Koriukivka region. An energy facility was also hit in Odesa overnight on Sunday, leaving 41,000 households without electricity.

Zelenskyy linked the success of these Russian strikes to limits that he said had been placed on Ukraine’s use of Starshield. The country’s military has been relying on the service since December 2024 to intercept Russian drones.

Starshield is a sister service to Starlink, a network of 11,000 satellites launched into low Earth orbit by SpaceX  to provide high-speed internet connectivity, even in remote areas.

In a statement on X on Sunday, Zelenskyy said that Russia was targeting energy substations with Shahed drones, which both sides often use to attack each other.

He added that “many of these strikes are getting through because restrictions on the operating speed of Starshield terminals along the front line and in the temporarily occupied territories are still there”.

“We are counting on these restrictions being lifted. The protection of lives and Ukraine’s energy infrastructure ahead of winter directly depends on this,” he added.

Zelenskyy also accused Starlink’s sister service of throttling internet speeds and hampering military operations on Saturday. He said that the internet restrictions had been in place for five days.

This is not the first time Ukrainian officials have complained about limits on Starshield hampering Kyiv’s defence efforts.

Last month, Ukrainian defence officials said they had lost access to important satellite-based communications and that the disruptions had affected military missions. This came in the wake of heavy Russian missile and drone strikes, for which Ukraine said it had received no prior warning.

According to a November 2 report by the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), Starshield is critical to Ukraine since it helps in encrypting satellite communications, which are needed to guide drones in order to carry out interceptions.

“In addition to using Starshield service for strikes within Ukrainian territory occupied by Russian forces, Ukraine uses Starshield-equipped drones to intercept and defend against Russian drones, such as new jet-powered drones taking aim at Ukrainian critical infrastructure and civilian targets,” the CSIS report noted.

Without access to Starshield internet, these Ukrainian drones are unable to work as effectively.

“Our interceptor drones lose connection with their operators at a speed of 161 kilometres per hour (100 miles per hour) and simply cannot catch up with Russian jet-powered ‘shaheds’,” Zelenskyy said on X on Sunday.

After last month’s disruptions, Zelenskyy said on X that “intelligence on Russian ballistic missile launches helps save lives, and this is one of the most critical issues”.

“This is precisely what helps prevent people from being killed – when there is an early warning about ballistic missiles,” he added.

Last month, Serhiy Beskrestnov, a defence adviser to Zelenskyy, had posted on Telegram that SpaceX had also “implemented a speed limit” on Starlink terminals, capping internet speeds at 100mph (161km/h).

That meant any drones or missiles flying at more than 100mph lost their guidance connection.

“Our armed forces did not receive a warning about these restrictions, and this led to the failure of a number of missions,” he had said, adding that this was clearly “related to the current political situation”.

Officials have said the restrictions have also reduced capabilities for front-line logistics, reconnaissance and relaying signals.

Jet-powered drones are high-speed uncrewed aerial vehicles equipped with small turbojet engines rather than traditional propellers or piston engines.

In its war on Ukraine, Russia has increasingly deployed jet-powered variants such as the Geran-3, Geran-4, and Geran-5 models.

These drones fly at much higher speeds than traditional propeller-powered drones, making them significantly harder for Ukrainian air defences to intercept.

In August, 38 people were killed in the village of Myla in Ukraine, when a Russian drone attack struck an ammunition depot. Another 12 were killed in attacks across the country in September.

Ukraine’s Air Force spokesman Yurii Ihnat said in September that while the country has an interception rate of more than 90 percent against propeller-powered drones, that success rate falls to only 60 percent against jet-powered models.

Ukraine has, however, retaliated using its own drone systems, and has also struck Russian refineries, hitting 12 in August, along with two gas-processing plants and three oil shipment terminals, according to its defence ministry.

On Sunday, Ukraine’s army said it also shot down 106 of 132 Russian drones launched overnight.

But to counter Russia’s jet-powered drones more efficiently, Zelenskyy said he had told teams of Ukraine’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Defence, and the presidential office “to work as closely as possible with the American side and SpaceX” and remove restrictions on Starshield.

“It is important to be on the right side of history. It is essential to help Ukraine,” he said on Sunday.

Starlink, owned by US billionaire Elon Musk’s SpaceX, is yet to respond to recent accusations about Starshield from Zelenskyy.

But last month, the company and Musk denied restricting internet speeds.

Responding to a post on X by Ukraine’s former Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov, who said the speed limits were being lifted and demanded unrestricted internet speed, Musk wrote last month, “Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government.”

“Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS,” he said, referring to the US president.

Musk further clarified that Starlink is for “civilian or defensive activities and cannot be used for offensive military action, as doing so would be inappropriate for a commercial company” – an apparent attempt to differentiate it from Starshield.

Zelenskyy said in an interview with the Financial Times last month that US military officials had earlier warned Kyiv that Washington would block intelligence unless attacks on Russian energy infrastructure stop.

The Ukrainian leader added that he did not accept suggestions that the Starshield incident could have been a glitch. “It was not a technical problem; it was the will,” he said.

Tensions between Kyiv and Washington have been building since Donald Trump returned to the presidency last year, including over Washington’s increasing reluctance to militarily support Ukraine and its mounting efforts to forge a deal with Russia.

But Trump has said that it is Musk who controls Starlink’s operations in Ukraine.

When asked about internet restrictions in Ukraine, he told reporters last month that Musk had restored Kyiv’s access, while denying any White House role in the episode.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio also said last month that decisions about Starlink’s speed and access belong to Musk.

“The bottom line is that that is governed by a private commercial contract as to how ⁠⁠⁠⁠their stuff can be used and what speeds they’ll allow it to be used at,” Rubio had said.

Meanwhile, officials from Ukraine and Russia held peace talks in Abu Dhabi, in the United Arab Emirates, last week. The talks, mediated by the US, only yielded an agreement on a prisoner exchange and failed to make a breakthrough on ending the war, which is nearing the five-year mark.

The US, however, pitched a new pathway for Ukraine to join NATO, an aspiration that Kyiv has long held as a means to guarantee its defence against Russia.

According to Zelenskyy, Trump’s administration has suggested that Ukraine would need to agree to give up all of the Donbas region in the country’s east, which Russian President Vladimir Putin has demanded as one of his conditions for ending the war.

On Saturday, Zelenskyy told reporters that the prospect of Ukraine joining NATO in exchange for ceding territory had not been raised by members of the alliance before and reiterated that Kyiv would not give up any of its territories.

But Zelenskyy said if Ukraine received a peace deal which included security guarantees, the right to maintain a strong and well-funded Ukrainian army, and funds to rebuild the country, then he would hold a national referendum on the question of ceding territory in exchange for NATO membership.

The Kremlin has not yet responded to the latest US proposal. But it has maintained a strict position that Ukraine’s NATO membership is a red line for Moscow and a direct threat to Russia’s national security. In fact, Putin has also cited the issue of Ukraine’s NATO aspirations as one reason why Russia launched its war in 2022.

Moscow has, however, insisted that Ukraine should cede sovereignty over the Donbas region, in addition to parts of Zaporizhzhia and Kherson provinces that Russia already occupies.
news.content: ارتش اوکراین از دسامبر 2024 برای رهگیری پهپادهای روسی به سرویس اینترنت متکی بوده است. ولودیمیر زلنسکی، رئیس جمهور اوکراین هشدار داده است که محدودیت ها در سرویس اینترنت درجه نظامی Starshield اسپیس ایکس، عملیات پهپادهای اوکراینی را مختل کرده و تلاش های جنگی این کشور علیه روسیه را مختل می کند. در آخر هفته، دو نفر در حمله پهپاد جت‌ران روسی به آنچه مقامات اوکراینی «زیرساخت‌های حیاتی» در منطقه شمالی کوریوکیفکا نامیدند، کشته شدند. همچنین در شب یکشنبه یک تأسیسات انرژی در اودسا مورد اصابت قرار گرفت و 41000 خانوار را بدون برق گذاشت. زلنسکی موفقیت این حملات روسیه را به محدودیت‌هایی مرتبط دانست که به گفته او برای استفاده اوکراین از Starshield اعمال شده بود. نیروهای نظامی این کشور از دسامبر 2024 برای رهگیری پهپادهای روسی به این سرویس متکی بوده‌اند. Starshield سرویس خواهر Starlink است، شبکه‌ای متشکل از 11000 ماهواره که توسط SpaceX در مدار نزدیک زمین قرار داده شده‌اند تا اتصال اینترنت پرسرعت را حتی در مناطق دورافتاده فراهم کنند. زلنسکی روز یکشنبه در بیانیه‌ای در X گفت که روسیه با پهپادهای شاهد، که هر دو طرف اغلب از آنها برای حمله به یکدیگر استفاده می‌کنند، پست‌های برق را هدف قرار می‌دهد. او افزود که «بسیاری از این حملات موفق می‌شوند زیرا محدودیت‌های مربوط به سرعت عملکرد ترمینال‌های Starshield در امتداد خط مقدم و در مناطق تحت اشغال موقت همچنان وجود دارد».«ما امیدواریم که این محدودیت‌ها برداشته شوند. حفاظت از جان افراد و زیرساخت‌های انرژی اوکراین

news.originalContent:
The Germany coach believes anyone who replaces the FIFA president should care deeply about the future of football.

Germany coach Jurgen Klopp has called for an end to Gianni Infantino’s time as FIFA president, saying he “did not think things could get worse after Sepp Blatter”.

Klopp believes the next candidate for the job of leading football’s global governing body should have the game’s interests at heart.

“I’ve been following football for many years. There are people who are much more knowledgeable about this than I am. But I think most people now agree a change would make a lot of sense,” Klopp said on Sunday in Berlin ahead of his team’s Nations League clash with the Netherlands.

“I didn’t think things could get worse after Sepp Blatter, but someone has managed to do just that.”

President of FIFA from 1998, Blatter resigned in disgrace in 2015 amid corruption allegations. He later faced charges before being cleared in two trials, but was banned from football by FIFA’s ethics committee.

Klopp added: “Regarding Gianni Infantino, surely the next person to come along can do a better job.”

Swiss-born Infantino, who succeeded Blatter as FIFA president in 2016, has been criticised for a series of decisions and proposals, including his plan to sell off part of the commercial rights of the World Cup. He was also lambasted for last year’s creation of the FIFA Peace Prize, and for giving the inaugural award to United States President Donald Trump.

“There are people who truly care about the future of football — people who aren’t driven by financial interests,” said Klopp. “If someone like that were to step up — if someone like that were to become president — I think that would be a significant improvement.”

“There are surely people who care deeply about the future of football and have no financial interests in it,” he added.

The next election for FIFA president takes place in March 2027. Only former Swiss footballer Ramon Vega and Japan’s Kozo Tashima have announced their intention to run against Infantino.
news.content: سرمربی آلمان معتقد است که هر کسی که جایگزین رئیس فیفا شود باید عمیقاً به آینده فوتبال اهمیت دهد. یورگن کلوپ، سرمربی آلمان خواستار پایان دادن به دوران ریاست جیانی اینفانتینو به عنوان رئیس فیفا شد و گفت که او "فکر نمی‌کرد بعد از سپ بلاتر اوضاع بدتر شود". کلوپ روز یکشنبه در برلین و پیش از دیدار تیمش با هلند در لیگ ملت‌ها گفت: "من سال‌هاست که فوتبال را دنبال می‌کنم. افرادی هستند که از من در این مورد بسیار آگاه‌تر هستند. اما فکر می‌کنم اکثر مردم اکنون قبول دارند که تغییر بسیار منطقی است." بلاتر، رئیس فیفا از سال 1998، در سال 2015 در بحبوحه اتهامات فساد از سمت خود استعفا داد. او بعداً قبل از تبرئه شدن در دو دادگاه با اتهاماتی روبرو شد، اما کمیته اخلاق فیفا از حضور در فوتبال محروم شد. کلوپ اضافه کرد: "در مورد جیانی اینفانتینو، مطمئناً نفر بعدی که می آید می تواند کار بهتری انجام دهد." اینفانتینو سوئیسی الاصل که در سال 2016 جانشین بلاتر به عنوان رئیس فیفا شد، به دلیل مجموعه ای از تصمیمات و پیشنهادات از جمله برنامه وی برای فروش بخشی از حقوق تجاری جام جهانی مورد انتقاد قرار گرفته است. او همچنین به دلیل ایجاد جایزه صلح فیفا در سال گذشته و اعطای جایزه افتتاحیه به دونالد ترامپ رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده مورد انتقاد قرار گرفت.

news.originalContent:
Romelu Lukaku, Belgium’s all-time leading goalscorer, has announced his retirement from international football after 16 years, saying he was “at peace” with his decision.

“These 16 years I gave all I had for the national team. It was a nice ride and I enjoyed every single moment,” Belgium’s record goalscorer said on Instagram on Monday.

With 94 goals in 135 games, Lukaku is the fifth-highest scorer in men’s international football history and featured in four World Cups for the Red Devils, helping them reach the quarterfinals of this year’s tournament before losing to eventual winners Spain.

The 33-year-old, who now plays for Turkish club Fenerbahce, made his debut in 2010 as a teenager and was an unused substitute in Sunday’s 4-1 Nations League win over Italy.

“To the Belgium fans, thank you for the support you gave our team. I am proud to have represented my country in 4 World Cups and 3 European Championships.

“I will never forget those moments. I’m at peace with my decision to stop here,” Lukaku said.

The former Chelsea, Manchester United and Inter Milan forward was part of Belgium’s so-called “golden generation”.

Lukaku, alongside Kevin De Bruyne, Thibaut Courtois and Eden Hazard, finished third at the 2018 World Cup, a best-ever finish for Belgium in the tournament, but they failed to lift a trophy during the period.

“I played with amazing teammates that I will always be grateful for,” Lukaku said.

“I want to thank them all. I want to thank all the coaches as well for pushing and trusting me to help the team,” he added.

The national team paid homage to Lukaku shortly after his announcement.

“More than a goalscorer, you have been a leader, a strong personality and an inspiration to generations of Belgian football fans,” said a post on Instagram by the Red Devils. “You have written an incredible chapter in the history of the Red Devils.”

A host of fellow Belgian players also paid tribute to Lukaku.

“Legend, my brother,” midfielder Axel Witsel posted on Instagram.

“Thank you for everything my bro,” Courtois said.

“So many amazing memories,” the Real Madrid goalkeeper added.

Lukaku’s last appearance for his country came in October’s 4-1 loss to France.

“Beyond his exceptional performances on the pitch, he has been a true leader, with a strong personality and an essential role in the dressing room,” Lukaku’s former teammate and now Belgium’s technical director, Simon Mignolet, said in a statement from the Belgian football association.

“We respect his decision and are deeply grateful to him for everything he has brought to our national team,” the former Liverpool goalkeeper added.

Belgium’s first game without Lukaku will be a Nations League last-eight fixture in March.

“We must now turn our attention to the future and prepare for the Nations League quarterfinals … with the ambition of continuing to make progress as a team,” Mignolet said.

news.originalContent:
هفته گذشته وقتی بی‌بی‌سی ویدئویی از روشن شدن چراغ‌های کریسمس در خیابان کارنابی لندن منتشر کرد، بخش نظرهای آن پر شد از واکنش هزاران نفر به چیزی که دیده بودند.

واکنش کاربران، نه به چراغ‌های درخشان و نه به آتش‌بازی زیبا که به دریای تماشاگرانی بود که با گوشی‌هایشان فیلم می‌گرفتند.

یکی نوشته بود: «یادتان هست وقتی چیزها را مستقیم با چشم خودمان نگاه می‌کردیم؟ چه روزگار خوشی بود.» دیگری فقط نوشته بود: «چه صحنه غم‌انگیزی، واقعا غم‌انگیز.»

ناتالی کسیدی، بازیگر پیشین سریال ایست‌اندرز، نوشت: «چرا این گزارش به این موضوع اشاره نمی‌کند که هیچ‌کس این نمایش زیبا را با چشم خودش نگاه نمی‌کند؟ واقعا ترسناک و ناامیدکننده است.»

بسیاری در نظرهایشان پرسیده بودند چرا آدم‌ها به جای این که آتش‌بازی را با چشم خودشان ببینند، از آن فیلم می‌گیرند. یکی نوشته بود: «چه خوب که همه در لحظه زندگی می‌کنند. ۹۰ درصد احتمال دارد هیچ‌وقت هم دوباره این ویدئو را تماشا نکنند.»

از زمانی که تقریبا گوشی همه، دوربین دارد، پژوهش‌های متعددی انجام شده تا مشخص شود که ثبت رویدادها با عکس یا فیلم چه اثری بر حافظه ما می‌گذارد.

بسیاری از این پژوهش‌ها به این نتیجه رسیده‌اند که عکس یا فیلم گرفتن از چیزی، نه تنها به ما کمک نمی‌کند آن لحظه را به خاطر بسپاریم، بلکه در واقع ممکن است مانع شود آن را دقیق به یاد بیاوریم.

دانشمندان اسم این پدیده را «آسیب ناشی از عکس گرفتن» گذاشته‌اند؛ اصطلاحی که نخستین بار دکتر لیندا هنکل، روان‌شناس، در سال ۲۰۱۴ و در جریان پژوهش درباره این موضوع به کار برد.

پژوهش‌ها و آزمایش‌هایی که بعدها درباره حافظه انجام شد، بارها نشان داده که انسان‌ها ناخودآگاه کار به خاطر سپردن را به دوربین می‌سپارند و دیگر مغزشان را برای به یاد سپردن رویدادها در همان لحظه‌ای که اتفاق می‌افتند، به کار نمی‌گیرند.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

برای دکتر کیتلین رگر از دانشگاه کالج لندن، نکته جالب این ماجرا آن همه آدمی نیست که فیلم می‌گیرند، بلکه کسانی است که در فضای مجازی از این موضوع عصبانی‌اند: «امسال اولین سالی نیست که آدم‌ها به مراسمی می‌روند و آن را از پشت صفحه نمایش تماشا می‌کنند اما نکته مهم این است که امسال بحث‌های انتقادی زیادی در افکار عمومی شکل گرفته است. به نظرم این واقعا، اتفاقی مثبت است.»

به گفته این استاد دانشگاه، نظرهایی مثل آنچه زیر ویدئوی خیابان کارنابی نوشته شده، «چیزهای زیادی درباره جایگاه کنونی ما به‌عنوان یک جامعه می‌گوید» و نشان‌دهنده «ناخشنودی ما از میزان نفوذی است که شرکت‌های بزرگ فناوری بر زندگی‌مان دارند.»

خانم رگر می‌گوید که این تغییر نگرش نسبت به گوشی‌ها و فیلم گرفتن از رویدادها دلایل مختلفی دارد؛ از جمله ممنوعیت استفاده از شبکه‌های اجتماعی برای افراد زیر ۱۶ سال در بریتانیا که قرار است از مارس ۲۰۲۷ اجرا شود و همچنین شکایت‌هایی در آمریکا که از شرکت‌های شبکه‌های اجتماعی مطرح شده است.

به گفته او، این خبرهای منفی‌تر «درک عمومی» را بالا برده و مردم را تشویق می‌کند که «بخواهند کنترل بیشتری بر این فناوری‌ها داشته باشند.»

کیتلین رگر گفت که شاید «موج انتقادها» از ویدئوی خیابان کارنابی به این دلیل باشد که پای کریسمس در میان است و مردم به‌شدت معتقدند که کریسمس را نباید از پشت گوشی تجربه کرد: «ما، به‌عنوان پدر و مادرهای نسل هزاره، کریسمس‌های پیش از گوشی‌های هوشمند را به یاد داریم.»

«تصورات خیلی عمیقی از معنای آن روزها برای خودمان داریم و فکر می‌کنم آدم‌ها روزبه‌روز بیشتر از این ناراحت می‌شوند که بچه‌هایشان همان تجربه‌ها را ندارند، یا از این که فناوری میان بچه‌هایشان و این تجربه‌ها فاصله انداخته است. پدر و مادرها حالا واقعا از سلطه‌ای که فناوری بر زندگی خانواده‌شان پیدا کرده، ناراحت شده‌اند.»

news.originalContent:
A rape conviction for the British comedian and actor leads to a reckoning for the media that kept him in the spotlight.

The conviction of comedian and actor Russell Brand for rape and sexual assault is a moment of reckoning for Britain’s entertainment industry. Some of the country’s most influential media institutions gave him the platforms, credibility and audiences that made him such a prominent public figure, and continued to do so as more and more allegations of sexual misconduct and predatory behaviour surfaced.

Contributors:
Dorothy Byrne – Former head of news and current affairs, Channel 4
Caroline Frost – Entertainment journalist
Dalia Gebrial – Lecturer, King’s College London and author of Decolonising the University
Ellie Tomsett – Film and media lecturer, Birmingham University

Novaya Gazeta, Russia’s last major independent newspaper, has been forced to shut down after years of pressure from the authorities.

Meenakshi Ravi reports on how the outlet went toe-to-toe with the Kremlin.

From slot machines to betting apps, gambling is a big part of Australian culture. Advertisers know it is something people often do with friends, and they have tapped into that trend. Australians are bombarded with slick marketing that promotes betting with mates.

Elettra Scrivo reports on one of the world’s most entrenched gambling industries, the advertising that props it up and the lobby that protects it.

Featuring:
Alex Russell – Research Fellow, Experimental Gambling Research Lab
Kate Seselja – Founder, The Hope Project Australia and co-chair, Gambling Harm Lived Experience Experts
Steve Cannane – Reporter, ABC Australia Four Corners
news.content:
محکومیت به تجاوز برای کمدین و بازیگر بریتانیایی منجر به حسابرسی برای رسانه‌هایی می‌شود که او را در کانون توجه نگه داشته است. محکومیت کمدین و بازیگر راسل برند به‌خاطر تجاوز و تجاوز جنسی، لحظه‌ای برای حسابرسی صنعت سرگرمی بریتانیا است. برخی از بانفوذترین نهادهای رسانه‌ای کشور به او پلتفرم‌ها، اعتبار و مخاطبانی دادند که او را به یک چهره عمومی برجسته تبدیل کرد و با ظهور هرچه بیشتر اتهامات سوء رفتار جنسی و رفتار غارتگرانه به این کار ادامه دادند. مشارکت‌کنندگان:
دوروتی برن - رئیس سابق اخبار و امور جاری، کانال 4
کارولین فراست - روزنامه نگار سرگرمی دالیا جبریال - مدرس کالج کینگ لندن و نویسنده کتاب استعمارزدایی از دانشگاه
الی تامست - مدرس فیلم و رسانه، دانشگاه بیرمنگام
نوایا گازتا، آخرین روزنامه مستقل مهم روسیه، پس از سال‌ها فشار مقامات مجبور به تعطیلی شد. میناکشی راوی گزارش می‌دهد که چگونه این رسانه با کرملین روبه‌رو شد. از دستگاه‌های اسلات گرفته تا برنامه‌های شرط‌بندی، قمار بخش بزرگی از فرهنگ استرالیا است. تبلیغ‌کنندگان می‌دانند که این کاری است که مردم اغلب با دوستان خود انجام می‌دهند، و از این روند استفاده کرده‌اند. استرالیایی‌ها با بازاریابی نرمی که شرط‌بندی با دوستان را ترویج می‌کند بمباران می‌شوند. Elettra Scrivo در مورد یکی از ریشه‌دارترین صنایع قمار جهان، تبلیغاتی که آن را حمایت می‌کند و لابی که از آن محافظت می‌کند گزارش می‌دهد.
الکس راسل - محقق، پژوهشگر تجربی قمار L
